maddie: Hey all — first week here! Quick question: who owns the on-call & escalation matrix for inference infra vs platform? Also who should I ping for access to the new-dev GPU cluster and PagerDuty coverage?

leo: welcome! :tada: short answer: eng-sre owns infra on-call, eng-runtime owns inference runtime on-call. For access requests, ping #help or @sam from people-ops for IAM provisioning.

arjun: adding: eng-platform owns model serving config + rollout policies (canary/A-B). If runtime is degraded, page eng-runtime first. If it's a broader infra issue (nodes, networking, storage), page eng-sre.

sam: tagged — I can add you to the PagerDuty rota for new-hires, but we'll need your manager's approval. Please fill the access request form: https://redwood.internal/tools/access-request (choose "gpu-cluster" and "pagerduty").

leo: escalation path quick reference (short):
```
1) incident detected -> page team-specific on-call (eng-runtime OR eng-sre)
2) no ack in 5m -> page second-tier (platform leads: @arjun)
3) 15m without mitigation -> page incident commander & exec on-call
4) if security concerns -> page eng-security immediately
```

maddie: awesome, thanks. small follow-up — where are the runbooks?

arjun: runbooks live in the runbooks repo and we have a curated inference set here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-oncall. If you don't have repo access, @sam will add you after the form.

infra-bot: NOTE: eng-sre pagerduty rotation has a scheduled change on 2026-06-01. Check on-call calendar for overlaps: https://redwood.internal/oncall-calendar

leo: also FYI — for urgent deploy rollbacks, call out "rollback" in the Slack thread and tag eng-runtime; our playbook auto-sends the rollback checklist.

maddie: perfect, thanks everyone! I'll submit the form now and ping back once I'm added to the rota. :raised_hands:
